title: Tension magnitude
description: Essential: Correctly calculates tension as T = mg/cosθ.

title: Resultant force magnitude
description: Essential: Correctly calculates resultant force as F_res = mg tanθ.

title: Vertical force balance
description: Important: Applies Newton's first law to balance vertical forces (T cosθ = mg).

title: Horizontal resultant identification
description: Important: Recognizes that resultant force equals horizontal component of tension (T sinθ).

title: Free-body diagram setup
description: Optional: Draws or describes correct free-body diagram showing tension, gravity, and resultant.

title: Unit consistency
description: Optional: Maintains consistent units or includes unit analysis.

title: Incorrect vertical resolution
description: Pitfall: Mistakenly uses T sinθ = mg or misresolves force components.

title: Sign/direction error
description: Pitfall: Assigns wrong direction to resultant force or tension components.
